observed_evidence: User-provided rendered source example shows the canonical URL pointing to a filtered archive instead of the product URL.
expected_behaviour: Canonical output should point to the preferred indexable URL for the product unless a documented customisation intentionally changes it.
impact: May consolidate signals to the wrong URL and create duplicate-content confusion for product pages.
recommended_action: Check the rendered source across a sample of products, then inspect theme/plugin code for canonical filters before changing configuration.
qa_check: After the fix, confirm canonical output on simple and variable products, product sitemap inclusion, and noindex/sitemap consistency.
